learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: the New York state page (/states-ny/) holds 11 product cards; other states have their own /states-<xx>/ pages. WordPress, but products are not on the REST API.
notes: A card's title is its eyebrow (the line: 'LEVEL 5', 'Protab Max', 'Protab+ ™', 'Protab ™') and its h4 (the product: 'ENERGY', 'Sativa – 2-Pack', 'Boost'), read together as 'LEVEL 5 | ENERGY'. Body is the spec list: 'Dose 20 mg THC / tablet Quantity 5 tablets / package Duration ...'.
The h4 of a LEVEL 5 card is in capitals ('ENERGY'); title_case writes 'Level 5 Energy'.

Package size is dose per tablet times tablets per package, and sizes.py cannot read 'N tablets / package' as a pack. Protab Max names its pack in the title ('2-Pack'), so its size is read: 50 mg x 2-Pack = 2pk 100mg. The others are constants, each guarded by the card's exact Dose and Quantity text, so a changed card falls to unparsed instead of keeping a stale size.

The constants use THC per tablet from each product's own page, because the cards give total cannabinoids for LEVEL 5 and Protab+: LEVEL 5 is 5 mg delta-9 THC (plus THCv, CBG) x 20 = 20pk 100mg; Recover is 10 mg THCa (plus CBDa, CBG, CBC) x 10 = 10pk 100mg; Boost and Lights Out are 20 mg THC x 5 = 5pk 100mg; Protab is 20 mg THC x 5 = 5pk 100mg. Stores sold exactly these on 2026-10-05.

The site writes Boost, Lights Out and Recover's line 'Protab+'. Stores write 'Protab', and the matcher reads '+' as 'and' ('protaband'), so the recipe writes the line 'Protab' for both. They do not collide: Protab is Sativa/Hybrid/Indica, Protab+ is Boost/Lights Out/Recover.
Stores list LEVEL 5 Slumber as 'Protab Slumber' (20pk 100mg); the brand's line is LEVEL 5, so it shows as store-only in check. A 2pk 20mg 'Protab Slumber' at stores is not on the NY page.

when.body: ^Dose 5\+? mg cannabinoids / tablet Quantity 20 tablets / package\b
^Dose 30\+? mg cannabinoids / tablet Quantity 10 tablets / package\b
^Dose 20 mg cannabinoids / tablet Quantity 5 tablets / package\b
^Dose 20 mg THC / tablet Quantity 5 tablets / package\b
